title: DynGhost: Temporally-Modelled Transformer for Dynamic Ghost Imagings
abstract: arXiv:2605.10185v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Ghost imaging reconstructs spatial information from a single-pixel bucket detector by correlating structured illumination patterns with scalar intensity measurements. While deep learning approaches have achieved promising results on static scenes, two critical limitations remain unaddressed: existing architectures fail to exploit temporal coherence across frames, leaving dynamic ghost imaging largely unsolved, and they assume additive Gaussian noise models that do not reflect the true Poissonian statistics of real single-photon hardware. We present DynGhost (Dynamic Ghost Imaging Transformer), a transformer architecture that addresses both limitations through alternating spatial and temporal attention blocks. translated_title: DynGhost：面向动态鬼成像的时序建模Transformer
translated_abstract: 鬼成像通过将结构化照明图案与标量强度测量值进行关联，从单像素桶探测器中重建空间信息。尽管深度学习方法在静态场景上已取得令人瞩目的成果，但两个关键局限仍未得到解决：现有架构未能利用帧间的时序相关性，使动态鬼成像在很大程度上成为悬而未决的问题；同时它们假设加性高斯噪声模型，无法反映真实单光子硬件实际的泊松统计特性。我们提出了DynGhost（动态鬼成像Transformer），这是一种通过交替的空间注意力与时间注意力模块来克服上述两项局限的Transformer架构。我们基于物理精确的探测器仿真（SNSPD、SPAD、SiPM）和Anscombe方差稳定归一化构建的量子感知训练框架，解决了导致经典模型……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: DynGhost提出了一种采用空间-时间交替注意力机制的Transformer架构，并配合基于物理精确单光子探测器仿真与Anscombe方差稳定归一化的量子感知训练框架，首次实现了动态鬼成像的时序建模，同时解决了真实泊松噪声带来的分布偏移问题。
en_tdlr: DynGhost introduces a transformer with alternating spatial-temporal attention blocks and a quantum-aware training framework based on physically accurate single-photon detector simulations and Anscombe variance-stabilizing normalization, enabling temporally-coherent dynamic ghost imaging under realistic Poissonian noise.
